Gir: Gir is a well-known Indian dairy breed known for high milk yield and heat tolerance.
Holstein_Friesian: Holstein is a high-yield dairy cattle breed famous for black and white markings.
Jaffrabadi: Jaffrabadi is a buffalo breed from Gujarat known for heavy body and high milk production.
Jersey: Jersey is a British dairy breed known for high butterfat content in milk.
Murrah: Murrah is a superior buffalo breed known for high milk yield.
Sahiwal: Sahiwal is one of the best dairy breeds from Punjab region.
